question: Anahat Singh is associated with which of the following sports events?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Squash**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Anahat Singh** is a young and talented squash player from India, known for her exceptional performance at the junior level.
 
• She gained prominence by winning the **U-11, U-13, and U-15 titles** at various international squash tournaments.
 
• Anahat represented India in the **Birmingham 2022 Commonwealth Games** at just 14 years of age, making her the youngest participant in squash at the event.
 
• She has achieved significant success, including a title at the prestigious **British Junior Open Squash** tournament.
 
• Anahat Singh is regarded as a rising star in Indian squash, showcasing immense potential to excel on the global stage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Squash:**

 
 
• Squash is a racquet sport played by two players (singles) or four players (doubles) in a four-walled court.
 
• The game involves hitting a small, hollow rubber ball against the walls of the court.
 
• It requires agility, precision, and tactical thinking, making it a physically demanding sport.
 
• Squash has been recognized by the **World Squash Federation (WSF)**, which governs international competitions.
 
 
 
• **British Junior Open Squash:**
 
 
• The British Junior Open is one of the most prestigious junior squash tournaments in the world.
 
• It attracts top junior players globally and serves as a platform for young talent to showcase their skills.
 
• Anahat Singh’s victory at this tournament highlights her skill and potential in squash.
 
 
 
• **Commonwealth Games:**
 
 
• The Commonwealth Games is a multi-sport event involving athletes from the Commonwealth of Nations.
 
• Squash has been a part of the Commonwealth Games since 1998, offering a platform for global competition.
 
• Anahat Singh’s participation in the 2022 Games marked a milestone for Indian squash.
 
 
 
• **India's Rising Stars in Squash:**
 
 
• India has seen a growth in squash popularity due to players like **Dipika Pallikal**, **Saurav Ghosal**, and **Joshna Chinappa**.
 
• Anahat Singh is considered part of the next generation of Indian squash players aiming to achieve international acclaim.
